openActions.title: Adopt a 4-hour PR first-response target
openActions.description: Define a team norm for first review comment or approval within 4 business hours; addresses idle reviews (FB-0003, FB-0005).

openActions.title: Require acceptance criteria before sprint commitment
openActions.description: Sprint-readiness checklist gate before stories enter the sprint (FB-0004, FB-0006).

openActions.title: Run a post-deploy smoke test checklist
openActions.description: Short post-deploy smoke tests after releases to sustain deployment reliability (FB-0001).

openActions.title: Schedule weekly pairing blocks for knowledge sharing
openActions.description: Regular pairing slots to extend a practice the team found effective (FB-0002).

reportExcerpt.themesSummary: Release and deployment reliability: The team reported that the deployment pipeline remained stable across all releases during the sprint. Collaboration and pairing: Pair programming was cited as helping the team complete the API migration more quickly. Code review responsiveness: Pull request reviews experienced multi-day idle periods; the team suggested a first-response target for reviews. Sprint readiness and acceptance criteria: Stories entered the sprint without clear acceptance criteria; the team proposed a readiness checklist before sprint entry.
